scope: Inert local process/IPC planning only; no CTP/native/provider/credentials/private config/network/SCM/default-preflight integration.
deadline_contract: For the existing whole-command claim, T0 precedes externally visible launch; D=T0+budget is immutable and includes launcher/bootstrap through final receipt delivery, required process exit/Job-empty, pending-I/O completion, and control release. Any missing fact at D is irrevocable UNKNOWN; late cleanup cannot upgrade.

cases.title: Single T0 and complete command path
cases.inject: Delay outer child launch/bootstrap, trust checks, readiness, admission, worker, receipt, Job drain and control release separately while summing against one D.
cases.required: Record every boundary; never reset D. Any completion after D fails whole-command contract; preserve late cleanup separately.

cases.title: Prewarm/READY blocked and not-ready request
cases.inject: Block service/worker prewarm, broker connection, readiness check, restart.
cases.required: Whole-command caller is bounded from T0 and never reports accepted/observed. A separately approved request-only contract may reject NOT_READY; startup remains distinct.

cases.title: CreateProcessW blocked before child creation
cases.inject: Wrapper-before-call gate and separately supported native/API fault injection.
cases.required: No request-time CreateProcess after READY. Wrapper is not labeled true syscall hang. Held call requires external live custodian and retained controls; else UNKNOWN/closed.

cases.title: Child exists before process-create call returns
cases.inject: Gate after child creation before PROCESS_INFORMATION return; separately name wrapper/native cases.
cases.required: Child is in exact Job from first instruction, no breakaway. No success without exact exit/job facts by D.

cases.title: ResumeThread before/after side effect
cases.inject: Gate before resume and after runnable transition before API return.
cases.required: No request-time resume after READY; setup path retains exact Job+process controls; UNKNOWN absent facts by D.

cases.title: Synchronous admission saturation
cases.inject: Full/unread pipe or blocked peer on dispatch attempt.
cases.required: Accepted caller stack performs no synchronous pipe/queue I/O. Submit time is separate from terminal result.

cases.title: Overlapped I/O pending and cancellation
cases.inject: Pending connect/read/write; CancelIoEx TRUE, ERROR_NOT_FOUND, other error, delayed completion, endpoint disconnect.
cases.required: Issuing live process owns handle/OVERLAPPED/event/buffer until exact completion is consumed; no close/reuse while pending.

cases.title: User-mode event-consumer hold vs kernel delay
cases.inject: Hold consumer after event separately from supported deterministic kernel-completion delay.
cases.required: Do not conflate. If true kernel delay is unavailable, record as untested.

cases.title: Caller death with pending I/O
cases.inject: Kill caller while broker/client/server operations are pending.
cases.required: Broker/server reaper survive and own their endpoint contexts; caller death gives UNKNOWN; later completion/empty cannot upgrade.

cases.title: Broker death with pending I/O
cases.inject: Terminate client broker while server operation remains pending.
cases.required: Server retains its own endpoint and Job controls; client death is not server completion; no reuse.

cases.title: Descendant tree and exact Job-empty
cases.inject: Worker+child+grandchild, early parent exit, breakaway, stale/nonzero/query failure.
cases.required: Retained exact Job; assignment closed; independent exit/exit code and ActiveProcesses zero by D; ignore child self-report.

cases.title: TerminateJobObject hangs/fails
cases.inject: Gate before API, after side effect before return, and return FALSE; label wrapper/native distinctly.
cases.required: UNKNOWN, retained duplicate controls, poisoned slot. No success unless independent proof finishes by D.

cases.title: Job query/handle close hangs or fails
cases.inject: Query blocks/fails/nonzero; CloseHandle blocks/fails before/after side effect.
cases.required: No Job-empty/release claim, success, or reuse. Failure of top guardian remains UNKNOWN.

cases.title: Unique reaper and guardian failure
cases.inject: Kill/wedge G1 during setup/terminate/query/close; separately kill/wedge G0.
cases.required: G0 acts from already duplicated exact controls. When G0 cannot run/return, record no user-mode empty proof and keep G1 closed; restart/kill-on-close is not proof.

cases.title: Receipt and output path
cases.inject: Block frame, receipt writer, flush/readback, response pipe and log/output writes before/after side effect.
cases.required: Receipt delivery and every request Job-empty/no-pending-I/O fact precede same D; later data is audit only.

cases.title: Monotone deadline
cases.inject: Apply small deterministic delays by phase until one D is crossed.
cases.required: One immutable D; all proof timestamps <=D for success. Late stage means UNKNOWN permanently.

cases.title: Caller disconnect/timeout
cases.inject: Disconnect during response wait while broker/reaper continue.
cases.required: Caller UNKNOWN; server retains ownership; IPC timeout is not Job-empty.

cases.title: Busy/poison/replay
cases.inject: Second request while old I/O/Job is pending; deliver old completion later.
cases.required: Reject/queue without changing first D; never reuse old handles/OVERLAPPED/generation.

cases.title: On-time and D+epsilon results
cases.inject: Short inert worker; repeat with terminal evidence after D.
cases.required: Success only if all on-time facts arrive; D+epsilon stays UNKNOWN forever.
